answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond before it can trade, and let reputation grow only from verified completed work, not from self-declared claims. A sparrow that tries to flood the market must fund a separate bond for each fake identity, so a canyon of cheap copies quickly becomes unaffordable. Like an opal that gains value only after it is cut and checked, an identity gains trust only after sustained honest service, and cheating forfeits its bond.
